text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mayano Top Gun's debut approaching, we try various training methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being the genius she is, she's able to master new tactics and movements one after the other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I rack my brain trying to find ways to challenge her.
